A special shoutout to the manager, Ami, who was an absolute pleasure to speak with. We told her this was our favourite dinner of our trip, and she surprised us with a couple of glasses of Prosecco — such a thoughtful and memorable gesture.

If you're looking for amazing food, top-notch service, and a great ambience, I highly recommend Gaucho. You will not be disappointed. And if you're lucky, you’ll get to meet Alex and Ami — they truly made our evening unforgettable!

Absolutely yum! We came here last week and had a great experience, from start to finish. All of the staff and servers were attentive, friendly and offered great recommendations. The food was absolutely delicious, packed full of flavour and they had lots of options for dietary needs (gluten free, vegan, etc), and we loved the cocktails and all of the yummy flavours. They even had a pre theatre menu which was very reasonable. I would recommend a visit if you're in Covent Garden!

Amazing cocktails and incredible staff, Kamani looked after us and served beautiful drinks!! Had some rosemary seasoned fries as a snack and sat at the bar. Now going to the theatre, perfect start to our evening out!!

I recently visited The Caravan Restaurant, and it turned out to be such a pleasant experience. I ordered a coffee and pudding, and both were absolutely spot-on — the coffee was rich and smooth, and the pudding was the perfect balance of sweet and comforting.

What truly stood out during my visit, though, was the service. I was served by an employee named Leighton, who was genuinely warm, attentive, and professional. It’s rare to come across someone who brings such positive energy to their role, and it made the experience feel personal and welcoming.

Leighton’s friendly demeanor and care in service really elevated the moment, turning what could have been an ordinary visit into something memorable.

Highly recommend Caravan — whether you’re in for a full meal or just something small, you’re in good hands.

This place feels like an office canteen, only super overpriced. Bunch if simple wooden tables with hard wooden chairs (thankfully some soft seating available too) and industrial interior. The so called pancakes with strawberries are actually 3 fat fried american style pancakes with literally 2 strawberries on top and some cream cheese plastered all over the plate - for the humble amount of £14. The Korean fried chicken is so deep fried that it could probably go safely to the sun and back. The toilets are not segregated and are down two flights of stairs but are at least clean. Staff was OK but I won’t be coming back.

The food was absolutely delicious and full of unique flavors. Every dish felt like a surprise in the best way! Our server Paulina was incredibly friendly and made the experience even more enjoyable. Highly recommend this place!

Just brilliant! Tasty steaks and Sunday roast served quickly and with sauces that truly add to the flavour rather than only add fat to the dish. Definitely the best mint sauce I have ever had.
The service was amazing.
I would recommend the All In Sunday roast with a Beefy Mary.
I love it when a restaurant does what it should right (serve great food) without pretentiousness.
The apple crumble and white chocolate cheesecake were excellent conclusions to a lovely roast.
The atmosphere could be a bit less noisy, but to be fair, that is just my preference and some people might consider that good vibes of a busy restaurant.

Visited Blacklock for the first time. Girlfriend booked it for a group of us based on reviews and location. You go in and down into the main area where it is all happening. This was busy and the atmosphere was buzzing. Service was excellent. I went for the 300g fillet and it was good ... very good! Had the crayfish salad for starter and was surprised at how good that was ... the avocado in the base salad is sublime. I did see the beef ribs starters coming out though and admit to some food envy but cannot complain as the crayfish salad was good and quite light before tucking into the steak main. I had the low alcohol beer served in an iced beer glass - nice!. Next time I'm going for the porterhouse! Will definitely be going back to this place and cannot recommend it enough. Superb.

Went around 5pm on a Thursday. They were able to seat us from walking in.

The steak was super lovely. Would recommend the prime rib. The Denver was nice but a tad chewy, however the chips and the bone marrow was lovely and would highly recommend.

We ordered dessert and got the cheesecake and crumble. Would recommend as well.

Had a very good experience at the restaurant but we were made unaware that the restaurant needed the table back at a certain time and it was towards the end of the meal that the host told us that they needed the table back asap which surprised us as we were not told at the beginning and were still waiting on our dessert.

We had the most amazing Sunday Roast at Blacklock Covent Garden – hands down the best we’ve ever had!

We ordered the All In Roast, which came with pork, beef, and lamb – all perfectly cooked and paired with delicious apple sauce, mint sauce, and mustard. The crispy pork crackling was a standout, and the vegetables were roasted beautifully. The giant Yorkshire pudding soaked in rich gravy was absolutely divine.

For dessert, we had the apple crumble with hot custard – comforting, warm, and exactly what we wanted to end the meal.

The atmosphere was vibrant and cosy, service was lovely, and the place was packed – so definitely book in advance to avoid missing out.

It had everything we love about a classic British Sunday Roast, done to perfection. Highly recommended!

Service was fantastic and very accommodating. It is definitely a busy place but considering how busy went very smoothly .

We went with the recommended "all in" but kind of wished I had not.

Don't get me wrong it was delicious but the bulk was 1 large pork chop which though delicious had a massive chunk that was all fat.

You then got a smallish sized lamb chop and a very small serving of steak.

It did however come with 3 crackers with different toppings each and 1 side each.

Next time I would probably just pick a separate meat from the menu then build around it.

I also ordered the bone marrow which I had never tried before and that was tasty.

All in all I do recommend however

places.name: Da Mario Covent Garden
places.editorial_summary: Italian classics in a simple dining room with framed art, black-and white photos and exposed bricks.

reviews.text: Yummy yummy yummy! Had the seafood pasta and bread with olive oil and balsamic and was absolutely delicious. Definitely on the pricier and upscale vibe but such a lovely place for a nice dinner, date, or professional meeting. My limoncello spritz was also good. The service was amazing too!

A brilliant experience start to finish. The staff were extremely attentive and went above and beyond. The food was 10/10, a very traditional Italian restaurant. Couldn’t recommend enough to anyone visiting the area. Thankyou!

Great food, good service! Apart from when we had to pay and the amount of money shown on the paying device was £143 instead of £56. It's a good thing my husband checked the sum on the device. Otherwise, it would have been a very expensive meal. We want to believe it was an honest mistake.  The staff were friendly and polite. The music on the speaker hanging from the tree was a nice touch.

This is a typical Italian restaurant located in a very Posh District of London. The prices are way above average, and the space inside is very little. Tables sit very close to each other, so you can hear what others are talking about. The food did not meet my expectations unfortunately. The service though is very attentive and fast. After 5 PM, there is a minimum order of a starter and a main dish. Keep this in mind.

We heard great things from reviews but da Mario restaurant in Covent Garden was above and beyond that. Entering we met Andrea who greeted us with a friendly handshake and made us feel at home. He gave us prosecco as we were celebrating our retirement.

The entire staff exceeded expectations and the food and drink as well as ambiance were all exceptional. We highly recommend you come to this Covent Garden gem. The staff and food will not let you down. Every table was enjoying themselves, as were we. We definitely will be back. Thank you so much for a wonderful experience.

places.name: Balthazar
places.editorial_summary: Artisan breads and patisseries all made in-house, with sandwiches and coffee for eat-in or takeaway.

reviews.text:
My new favourite restaurant in London, absolutely stunning food and amazing staff.
It was recommended to us by someone that lives in London, and what a find.
You walk into a vibrant ( but not too noisy) atmosphere, the service from every member of staff is impeccable- Rita our waitress was particularly helpful and friendly.
My pork chop was the best I’ve ever had, my wife’s salmon so so tasty and our desserts were simply amazing.
For the price you pay it’s simply amazing value for money.
Can’t wait to go back.

Love, love, love Balthazar's. Menu is great and atmosphere is always great as it is always so crowded. But not too noisy that you cant chat. Service is always excellent and staff are knowledgeable and helpful.

We came for a quick bite and order three things, king prawns, escargot and a cheese burger
The king prawns were probably 1.5-2 cms and when I mentioned it the manager came and insisted these were king prawns. There was no point arguing as he was adamant. The escargot were swimming in some oil and green paste without the shell and the burger was the worse we have ever had at a ‘nice’ restaurant. The patty was compressed and tasted equally flat.
Overall the service was great and quick, the managers know it all attitude when he clearly was wrong and the food quality was very disappointing.

Lovely seating, a mix of French and American bistro and diner. Service was a little slow but the food is quality and the prix fixe menu if you arrive between 11am-7pm on a weekday is a very good deal!

We had a truly disappointing experience here, despite being a long-time regular and booking well in advance for a party of eight.

When we arrived, our reserved table wasn’t ready, and we waited nearly 30 minutes. We tried to stay positive and had drinks at the bar in the meantime. Once seated, we ordered oysters, several dishes, and 4–5 bottles of wine. While the food itself was delicious, every single course arrived very late, and the waiting time became exhausting. Still, we remained patient and didn’t complain.

However, the situation turned unacceptable when, after only two hours, the staff repeatedly told us we had to leave the table for another group. This happened five times, even though the restaurant was far from full and there were plenty of empty tables around. By 10:30pm, the staff’s approach had become increasingly rude.

Spending over £1,000 and receiving this kind of treatment was extremely disappointing. I have never experienced this issue here before, but this time I was left embarrassed in front of my business partners.

places.name: Browns
places.formatted_address: 82-84 St Martin's Ln, Greater, London WC2N 4AG, UK
places.editorial_summary: All-day British chain brasserie & bar with lobster nights & afternoon tea in a grand cafe setting.

reviews.text: Nikos our waiter is hands down the best waiter ever! So attentive, we have had fantastic service. He made my mums birthday very special. We will definitely be back. Thank you Nikos. Also food and cocktails were delicious! Try the cherry margarita, you wont regret it

My experience here is amazing! The food is leaning more on the expensive side but it’s worth it - from the portion size to the quality. Everything’s cooked to perfection!

Added to my exquisite experience is the service! Ada was so accommodating and engaged! Definitely a quality service!

5/5 indeed, and highly recommended!

Browns Covent Garden is a delightful spot for a quintessentially English high tea with friends. The art-deco interior feels like stepping back into a glamorous 1920s London lounge, with gleaming brass accents and plush seating. Tiered trays arrive piled high with delicate sandwiches, warm scones, and decadent pastries, and the team is certified gluten-free and caters to allergies like true professionals. The lively yet relaxed atmosphere keeps conversation flowing as easily as the tea and bubbly, though the gluten-free tray could use a little more variety and a few extra fruits in the pot of cream to really shine. It’s popular for good reason, so be sure to book ahead for this stylish afternoon treat.
We had a lovely brunch on Sunday. Staff were attentive & professional. Food was amazing. Great atmosphere. Highly recommended. Anu was very helpful and gave us a great service.

I had the absolute pleasure of being looked after by Vida at Brown’s, and she honestly made the evening unforgettable. From the moment we arrived, her warm welcome and genuine smile set the tone. She was attentive without being intrusive, knew the menu inside out, and gave brilliant recommendations that were spot on.

What really stood out was the way she went the extra mile – nothing felt like too much trouble, and she managed to balance professionalism with such a friendly, personal touch. It felt like we were being hosted rather than just served.

Vida is a credit to Brown’s – if you’re lucky enough to have her as your waitress, you’re in for a fantastic experience!

places.name: Banana Tree Covent Garden
places.editorial_summary: Pan-Asian fare served in a lively, industrial-chic restaurant with a bar & happy hours.

reviews.text: Excellent service at this restaurant. Came to London to celebrate mine and my twin girls' birthdays. Ahmed was extremely attentive. Food and drinks were served quickly and all was delicious. They made a big deal of it being our birthdays, serving us a lovely slice of banana and chocolate cake and ice cream with a candle and sang happy birthday. Was first time visiting this restaurant and would definitely come back.

Went before a theatre show and the food and service was exceptional!

We got the bang bang broccoli to start and it was so fresh with the perfect light coating on the outside of it.

For mains I had the Chicken Massaman curry and all I can say is that I have a new favourite dish! The balance of the flavours in the curry with the pickles on the side and crunch of the crackers was perfect.

2-4-1 cocktails were also absolutely delish, we got a Long Island iced tea and the Jungle Bird.

What a great restaurant in Covent Garden. The music, energy, friendly service, cleanliness, and delicious food made this wonderful. Whether dining solo, as a couple or big group - all are welcome. The laughter and chatter are so much fun!

Good vegetarian options, too.

Thanks Ahmed and team.

Great location and a good menu with plenty of vegan options to choose from. We ordered the Drunken noodles which were amazing and delicious. We also ordered the ramen dish which was sadly bland and the salt and pepper fries wore cold and stale too. I’d recommend other places to eat. Atmosphere was good. Service not great.
Food was amazing and very worth the money. Ahmed could not have been more attentive and hospitable, he was so lovely. Will be coming back !!

places.name: Inamo Covent Garden
places.editorial_summary: High-tech tables & menus in a cool Pan-Asian restaurant that has a games room.

reviews.text: Dinner with the family. We had high expectations because we love Asian food. The menu on the computer table looked cool and attractive so we had high expectations. We entered the restaurant, our order was waiting for us. The menu was easy to use and matched the pictures and description. The service was very good. A little hot in the restaurant space but reasonable. Then the dishes arrived at the table. There were 4 of us and we ordered 9 dishes. We said if we wanted, we would take more. Very small dishes arrived. Most of them were not tasty. Strange and unbalanced seasoning. The main dish. which was delicious was the fried cauliflower. We decided not to order anything else. We went to finish our dinner somewhere else. We left very disappointed

We visited Inamo Covent Garden in September 2025 and tried the all-you-can-eat menu (£49 per person). The concept and interactive tables are quite unique and fun, and the staff were friendly and efficient.

However, the food didn’t fully meet our expectations — a few dishes lacked the freshness and flavour we were hoping for. Overall, it was an interesting experience, though the value for money could be improved.

The sushi tastes OK, but I’d avoid fried things because they are too oily. The spring rolls were dripping lots of oil. Prepare pills for the heartburn.

The service was friendly and they smile, but I have to give it a low mark because they didn’t do their job properly. We had to ask for plates several times. Only half way through our dinner they finally brought plates. Also, we ordered salmon with yuzu ponzu dressing, and it had no dressing. We asked about it, and they took it away, and we had to keep asking until 20 minutes later they brought it back… still with no ponzu or any other dressing. I think the staff doesn’t know what ponzu is so to avoid any further explaining, we put soy sauce on it and ate it like that.

One of the waiters was often asking “is everything OK?” but as I was saying “well, actually…” she was already gone.

The tables are touch panels from where you order. But they were sensitive to some of the plates we put on it and it was hard to order at times.

We were charged a technology fee for using the table menus while no other menu alternative was offered. While ordering the table menu crashed multiple times and everyone in our party agreed that we would have preferred paper menus. Several of the staff didn't really listen to us. We arrived with our party and needed to wait 5 minutes to be seated which was not an issue, but during that 5 minutes the same staff member irritably asked us 3 times about our reservation and each time we said "we're already waiting to be seated, thank you". Another staff member decided to show us how to operate the screens which was not necessary at all because one of our party had eaten there previously. A quick "have you eaten with us before?" would have been useful here. The food arrived fairly quickly but not always to the correct table. I asked twice if the dish I had just been handed was vegetarian and the server said "yes both times" only for my first bite to clearly reveal meat. I passed the dish along to a friend, but it was frustrating experience. All in all, some of the dishes were delicious, the Tamarind Mushrooms were beautiful! But with the unexpected (and mandatory) technology fee (£7.96 per table) + 12.5% service charge on top of already over priced dishes and infuriating table menus and checked-out staff this is not a place I'll be recommending to anyone.

We make an effort to visit this place every month, and the entire team consistently delivers an amazing experience, particularly Sumana, though everyone is wonderful. The food options are delightful, even for someone like me who enjoys milder flavors. There’s truly something for everyone. The modern atmosphere and interactive touchscreen ordering system are outstanding—definitely a step up from using an app at other restaurants!

places.name: Cora Pearl
places.editorial_summary: Hearty comfort food & handcraft cocktails served in a historic, chic Covent Garden townhouse.

reviews.text: Came here after a long day of walking in London for dinner. Stumbled upon this restaurant and had dinner. They admired our 7:30pm deadline to Adelphi Theatre, and helped us pick a good quick meal. We had the pork, salmon, 2 coconut soups (strongly recommended) and chips. It took 25 minutes for our food to get here, and for a restaurant that was not that empty, it was very pleasant. Prices are a little above average but the benefits outweigh the cons. Definitely worth visiting and will come back if i go to london again.

We were in town for some wedding shopping and stumbled cross this charming little bistro, so made a booking to return for lunch

The place is small, but you don’t feel like you are sitting on top of other guest.

The food was simply outstanding and who knew marmite butter could taste so good.

The service started well with attentive front of house staff but as the meal progressed, became slow and at times we felt ignored. This was disappointing given the place was not busy. At one point we had to ask for empty plates to be removed

Very nice and generous Sunday beef roast, the fish was also very good, just very small portion, the potato was very good and the coffee was also very good. They made a nice chocolate thick mousse stuff for birthday celebration which was very nice touch and very tasty, overall would definitely recommend it!

We had the sunday roast and it was heavenly. Worth it 100%. The chips were crunchy, the cauliflower cheese so cheesy. The service was really good too. They don’t have a kids menu but they tried there best to accommodate my daughter by offering half a roast.

Very enjoyable supper in a lovely room with stylish cocktails and food you really want to eat. The team were charming and we chatted about the courtesan Cora Pearl. Standout food was the cheese and ham toastie starter and the chips, which were recommended as ‘the best on London’ they were scrumptious and outrageously decadent ( reminded me of the Quality Chop House’s legendary chips) there is a set supper for pre theatre. Our cocktails were delicious and we split a carafe of dry Riesling. Lots of nice touches.

places.name: Osteria Napoletana
places.formatted_address: 186 Kensington Park Rd, ES W11 2ES, UK
places.vicinity: 186 Kensington Park Rd, Notting Hill, ES
places.editorial_summary: Area-sourced Neapolitan-style eats & an ample wine list in a cool eatery featuring outdoor seating.

reviews.text:
Lovely restaurant with delicious food! Make sure you book online, it requires a credit card to secure the booking on OpenTable.

Mattia was our waiter and absolutely lovely. He was very efficient and humorous too! I appreciated his help with the menu and it was a pleasure watching him masterfully mixing drinks!

The food was all lovely. The seafood was all done beautifully and not at all overcooked. All of the pasta was fresh and very tasty. Highly recommend the calzone, I loved the contrasting textures and how the tastes blended together beautifully in each bite! I thought that perhaps the salad could have done with a touch more salt, however it was a nice contrast to the other dishes. Note the other dishes were all seasoned wonderfully.

We particularly enjoyed the complimentary basket of bread. Really delicious selection and it had the perfect amount of sea salt. The tomatoes there were absolutely great, far beyond the normal ones you can get. Adds to the authentic feeling of this Italian restaurant!

The toilets are located downstairs. They are very clean and pleasant. It’s in keeping with the rest of the restaurant, which is well decorated both inside and out.

If you require one, there is a baby seat, it is located downstairs. I don’t believe there is a kids menu. The ragu is very good though and a good size for two young children to share (YMMV).

Prices are a little high here, however you definitely get what you pay for! Highly recommend for anyone looking to treat themselves!

Absolutely delicious! The pomodoro was authentic and full of flavor, but what really made the experience stand out was the special touch of having fresh basil cut right into the olive oil for dipping bread—simple, but unforgettable. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and every bite felt like a little trip to Naples. A truly lovely experience and a meal I’ll be thinking about long after London.

A lovely family gathering at this cozy Italian restaurant. All the dishes were perfectly prepared and well cooked. I recommend the Paccheri alla Scorfano and La Parmigiana di Melanzane. My daughter loved the Pasta Ammiscata Patate e Provola. The service was excellent as well.

WOW! 🤩 What a wonderful Neapolitan restaurant! Highly recommended! We had a stunning dinner for 2.
Everything we ate was gorgeous. The atmosphere is nice.
The waiters were lovely with lots of little attentions (though we were sat by the door and therefore were forgotten about on a few occasions for little details, but it doesn’t detract from my 5 ⭐).

Authentic italian taste

Small but very cozy place. Great attention, food delicious.
I would point offer free water.

Ticket average $40eur, kind expensive.

Recommended.

places.name: Granger and Co. Notting Hill
places.editorial_summary: International dining with an Aussie accent in airy, no-reservations dining room with large windows.

reviews.text:
Queue moved quickly and great service.

Nice cocktails and lattes. Unfortunately we'd just missed the brunch menu. Ordered the avocado with poached egg on toast which was really well made but simple.

Starting the day at Granger & Co. was such a treat. The ricotta hotcakes were the fluffiest things ever.. . absolutely delicious. I dined alone and found the atmosphere so welcoming and enjoyable. A perfect spot for a solo breakfast!

I had a wonderful breakfast experience at this lovely restaurant. The service was so warm and welcoming ♥️ it truly made my morning. The poached egg was absolutely the most delicious I’ve ever had, perfectly cooked and full of flavor. The pancakes were something special too, so unique and unlike any I’ve tried before. A perfect spot to start the day with a smile ♥️

We stopped by Granger & Co around 3pm for an afternoon snack and coffee. There was no wait, though the restaurant was lively and buzzing. We ordered a pot of fresh mint tea, a latte, and their famous hotcake. The ricotta hotcakes were incredible—super fluffy, not too sweet or greasy, and perfectly paired with caramelized bananas. Latte was fantastic as well. Service was excellent, with attentive and kind staff. Looking forward to coming back to try more of their dishes!

Came here after a long day to sit & enjoy some delicious looking food (website). Upon arrival, seating was tight so they offered to seat us outdoors which was appreciated. They took our drink order and by the time the drinks & water came, we were ready to order. The table water was brought in a pitcher with 2 small cups, they filled them halfway which I was okay with thinking they'd leave the pitcher but that wasn't the case. This was also the last time we were served water. We promptly ordered and the food arrived relatively quickly. I asked for a condiment for my fries. The burger had a great flavor but the bun was either old or completely over toasted. So much so that it overtook the burger flavor which was a shame. The fries were not what I'd expect from a restaurant. I'm sure the side condiments would've helped had I received them before the entirety of my meal was completed. We also never saw another server again before having to go inside and ask for the ticket. The server apologized repeatedly for "forgetting they had tables outside" but didn't offer to make anything better. I'm not too terribly sure how they forget there are outdoor tables when they have very large windows at the front of the restaurant offering a view. All in all, unfortunately, I wouldn't return and would be hard pressed to recommend the experience to others.

places.name: Gold
places.editorial_summary: Seasonal, thoughtfully sourced plates are served in this cool eatery that has a bar & a terrace.

reviews.text: Discovered this restaurant randomly while walking along Portobello road with my husband and can’t say I was disappointed. We walked in on a weekday afternoon and the place was relatively packed. Staff were very warm and friendly. Lots of vegetarian options, food was delicious and you could really taste the freshness of the ingredients. Excellent for a date or a business lunch!

Each dish showcased impressive detail, variety and complexity, though a couple felt like they were missing something but overall very tasty. Service was great, wonderful decor inside with decent music in the background which we didn’t expect. The vibe was great.

Gold Notting Hill delivers a memorable meal in a beautiful setting. The ricotta toast was light and flavorful, the sweet potatoes packed with depth, and the pastas—the veal tortelloni and ricotta ravioli—were both refined and delicious. The space itself is stylish yet welcoming, making it a spot I’d happily return to

Overall great food and lovely service. Wait staff were super helpful and honest re portion sizes etc. The burrata salad was great, the hispi cabbage is really different and grows on you as you progress through the meal. The sauce served with the squid is also very good. Nice mocktail options too. Lovely bathroom & overall environment.

We had a very nice dinner here. We sat upstairs, which felt more intimate and relaxed than the buzzy ground floor. Shared three starters - sweet potatoes, ricotta with sourdough, and a feta salad - all fresh and well-balanced. Mains were equally solid: the steak with aubergine sauce was rich and satisfying, and the sea bream was cooked just right. Only letdown was the cocktail, which didn’t quite hit the mark for us.

Quietly rated: worth stopping.

Had a nice experience - the tapas were well-executed with a nice variety of flavours - everything felt thoughtfully prepared. Service was friendly and attentive. A relaxed space that’s ideal for a casual catch-up or low-key date night. Would happily return!

This tapas spot in Notting Hill is a true gem! We followed their recommendation of 4-6 plates per couple, which was perfect for a satisfying and varied meal. The menu genuinely has something for everyone, from classic Spanish staples to more adventurous options. What really stands out is how the eclectic decor of this traditional Spanish restaurant is beautifully mirrored in the passionate presentation of the food. Every dish looked as good as it tasted. Highly recommend!

We had a wonderful experience here. The service was excellent — the staff were friendly, attentive, and very helpful, which made the visit even more enjoyable. The day’s special octopus was juicy and delicious, and the oxtail was cooked to perfection — I honestly can’t pick which one I enjoyed more. The food overall was fantastic, though the cheesecake was just average compared to the rest of the dishes. Still, a great place to dine and would happily come back again.

Fantastic food. Nothing is average here. Flavoursome croquettes, creamy burrata with rainbow baby tomatoes and a rich jam, chargrilled avos with mango - were all well presented and balanced dishes.
Scrumptious basque cheesecake with a perfect light texture and sharp passionfruit sorbet.
Staff were extremely helpful, friendly and personable. Cool arty interior added to a great experience. A must go to - will be back!

Excellent cute hole in the wall with a very cosy and welcoming atmosphere.
Tapas style plates that are generous on portions and very delicious for the price.
Additionally very reasonable wine by the glass!
Stand outs are the cod stuffed peppers and mushroom and manchego croquettes.
Need to come back for their slow cooked oxtail!

Exceptional food and service.  The sea bass ceviche was incredible, as was the broccoli and the steak. Not pictured but the best ever were the peppers.  Great service at the bar. Wonderful open kitchen gives a great atmosphere. Got a great little London rainstorm that drove everyone inside. Classic.
Every single time - perfect! it’s a joy to come here! Fab food, amazing wine list, great service! Well done! (our little doggy is welcome too which makes us love this place even more).

Yesterday’s experience at the restaurant was unfortunately disappointing. I had been looking forward to visiting after hearing so many positive things about both the food and service. We were a group of five, with friends visiting from Belgium, and while the food itself did not disappoint in particular, the prawn tartare and ox cheek pasta were absolutely delicious. The service fell far short of expectations and ultimately spoiled the evening.
To highlight a few issues: water was never topped up unless we waved and asked, empty glasses were left on the table all night (on one occasion the waiter removed only a single glass and walked away without a word), and our mains were left sitting on the pass because we hadn’t been given cutlery. The manager had to step in to resolve this. There were no checkbacks on starters, and throughout the evening the waiter seemed disengaged and uninterested. At one point I even saw him throw something near the bar till and have what appeared to be a heated discussion with a manager. His lack of presence and professionalism really detracted from what should have been a memorable evening.
To add to the disappointment, when we left, the host didn’t even say goodbye. Small touches like this make a big difference, and their absence was noticeable.
Overall, while the food was excellent, the service was nowhere near the standard I had been led to expect.

Amazing place, great vibe, the ambience was perfect for a good conversation with friends. The drinks are great, but the food was awesome both in presentation and taste. The tuna tartare is a winner. The pastas were also delicious. The service was really something, shout out to Ondrej who was very friendly, enthusiastic, and took interest in his customers. Overall the experience was amazing and this is highly recommended. On top of that the area where the place is is beautiful and warrants a nice afternoon drive.

Romantically tucked away in Notting Hill, this restaurant offers a truly unique Mediterranean dining experience. Its open-concept kitchen isn't just for show; it genuinely invites you to witness the culinary magic, creating a wonderful sense of transparency and engagement. The service, particularly from Ondrej, was impeccable. He warmly greeted us with complimentary champagne to celebrate our anniversary, a lovely touch. We chose the Chateaubriand for two from their nightly specials board, and it was grilled and rested to absolute perfection. With a generous selection of wines and cocktails, we know we'll be back.

places.name: LUSH & HUSH
places.formatted_address: 101 Notting Hill Gate, London W11 3JZ, UK

reviews.text: We had such a lovely experience today. The food was of excellent quality. The staff were also very warm and welcoming, which made the meal even more enjoyable. We’ll definitely be coming back again！☺️

Complete perfection.

Our waiter Chris was super welcoming, warm and knowledgeable.

The food was genuinely immaculate. The waygu was so good we immediately ordered a 2nd plate.

Highly, highly recommend.

The team advised us on food and were incredibly kind.

Thank you
I highly recommend Lush and Hush, incredible menu with super tasty food and very authentic dining experience. The staff are very attentive and polite. I can’t wait to visit again.

This is a lovely new bistro . We enjoyed a satisfying seafood paella with a crunchy socarat base, prawns and squid, followed by  a baked lemon sole with a medley of tomatoes, onions, and ginger. The flavors bespoke remarkably high quality ingredients and a deft blending that left each taste distinct and delightful.  A Wagyu spring roll with a mustardy dipping sauce and a heavenly Spanish pan con tomate preceded the mains. Jack was a welcoming and congenial host. We will return.
Super warmth local restaurant and loved the Wagyu beef & lobster pasta 🍝

We had the best experience at The Barbary Notting Hill! We tried everything and every single dish was full of flavor and beautifully prepared. The atmosphere is vibrant and stylish, and you can really feel the energy from the open kitchen. The service was absolutely amazing, friendly, attentive, and made the evening feel special from start to finish. Highly recommend for anyone looking for delicious food, great vibes, and outstanding hospitality. We’ll definitely be coming back!

Absolutely scrumptious meal. The service was excellent from the start. I particularly enjoyed the 7 Spice Lamb Rib, the Coffee Rub Chicken & the Orange wine to wash it down. I also loved the extra effort by the whole team when they signed a birthday card for me. Will definitely be back.

We recently stopped in for a martini and a light lunch at The Barbary Notting Hill, and the experience did not disappoint. We were greeted by the friendly head chef, who works behind the open fire grill, creating the most delightful smells of rich Mediterranean flavors. The light from the large windows lets in the busy city outside without the noise, and the architecture is modern and beautiful. The cherry and sumac sorbet was a great way to finish the meal. We will return and add The Barbary to our "favorites" list.

We had been planning to go there for a long time. Maybe we expected too much, but the food wasn’t very tasty(sashimi was good). It was good, just a bit too greasy for me, and the portions were quite small. Overall, it’s a nice place, but I was expecting more.

We had an amazing time at Barbary!
The food was absolutely delicious, and we loved the idea of sharing dishes.
The only minor hiccup was that we didn’t receive our main course on time, but the manager was super helpful and quickly rectified the situation. He even offered us dessert on the house as a gesture of goodwill.
We paired our meal with a couple of martinis and later with a lovely red wine, which was the perfect complement to the food.
Overall, it was a fantastic dining experience!

Zephyr Notting Hill is an absolute gem that truly transports you to the heart of Greece!
From the moment you step in, the atmosphere is wonderfully relaxing and truly immersive. It creates the perfect mood for a long, enjoyable meal.
Most importantly, the food is magnificent—it's authentic Greek cuisine with genuine, rich flavors that clearly speak to the quality of the ingredients and preparation.
The staff is highly qualified and professional, striking a perfect balance between attentiveness and warmth. They were excellent at guiding us and offering tailored recommendations based on our preferences, which made the experience even better.
We finished our meal on a high note with a wonderful dessert and super artisanal coffee!!
A perfect conclusion to a perfect evening.
Highly, highly recommend Zephyr for anyone looking for an authentic and delicious Greek dining experience in London. We can't wait to go back!

A special thank you to Teddy from Nina who recommended Zephyr Notting Hill and made sure we were well taken care of. From the moment we arrived, the experience was outstanding.

The food was absolutely delicious — every dish was full of flavor and beautifully prepared. We were even offered a complimentary dessert along with a couple of extra dishes to try as a gesture for my birthday which made the evening feel even more special.

The service was flawless, the atmosphere and vibes were perfect, and the décor added so much charm to the whole experience. Everything came together so smoothly that it made dining here truly memorable.

Zephyr Notting Hill is definitely a restaurant I’ll recommend and return to again.

had a wonderful evening at zephyr! the food is beautiful and the atmosphere is great. we got the aubergine dip which was such a standout and was so tasty, the yellowtail was also amazing! both of us normally don't enjoy raw fish but this was a great dish. the service can be a bit slow (but understandable as it gets so busy!), we did have a mistake with our bill but the staff were super friendly and corrected it for us immediately. would definitely return again soon

WORTH THE HYPE!

If anything, worth the visit for the Smoky Tommi and their signature crispy potato terrine alone.

Another must try is their incredible selections of dips! But my personal favourite was the seafood, definitely will be coming back for the yellowtail and prawns.

J’adore!!

A Truly Memorable Experience at Zephyr

After hearing so many glowing recommendations, I finally made it to Zephyr  and I can honestly say it exceeded all expectations.

From the moment we arrived, the service was impeccable. The manager,  I believe he was Italo-Moroccan  was incredibly helpful in walking us through the menu. He took the time to explain each dish with passion and detail, which really added to the whole experience.

We started with the spreads and a classic Greek salad  fresh, vibrant, and packed with flavour. Then came the lamb, which was simply outstanding. Tender, perfectly seasoned, and cooked to perfection. And dessert? The cheesecake was unforgettable  rich, creamy, and the perfect way to end the meal.

Our server was just as impressive professional, attentive, and thoughtful. He made sure we were looked after from start to finish, even changing our plates between courses, which is such a rare touch these days.

Zephyr isn’t just about great food, it’s about hospitality, care, and creating a memorable dining experience. I’m already looking forward to my next visit!

We got a small bottle of wine which was recommended to us by the waiter to match with our choices of main dishes. Which were a carbonara and an amatricana which both were very good and made with homemade pasta and guanciale. Also the carbonara was made the traditional way, without any cream AND it's the cheapest restaurant around Notting hill. Every other restaurant here charges 22+£ for carbonaras with cream. After we got a dessert and drinks as well, a tiramisu al pistacchio and two limoncellos, which were fantastic too. The waiters were helpful and kind. Accidentally we were handed the wrong table's bill, but it was handled professionally and kindly.
By the way, we got our food in less than 10 minutes.

This was such a lovely, lovely place.
The homemade pasta was delicious, and you could really tell that everyone there cared about what they were doing. We were lucky to meet the amazing owner, Stefano, who made the experience even warmer.

It honestly felt like a restaurant back home—comfortable, genuine, and full of heart. We’ll definitely be back.

Thank you all!

An absolute little gem of restaurant in the heart of Notting Hill - delicious authentic Italian dishes, decently priced for Central London and the portions are well sized and very filling. We visited last night a group of 3 people - and for starters we tried their tender beef meatballs, crispy rice balls similar to Arancini and deep fried squid , all very delicious and fresh. Pasta carbonara as a main was a trip back to Italy, such a delicious al dente & fresh egg pasta! Delicious fresh pizzas as well! My only regret was feeling too full at the end of the meals and not having enough space to try their sweet treats as well - a good reason to come back to this beautiful restaurant! Would definitely recommend it, staff were friendly and cheerful and they know how to make you feel transported back to an Italian holiday 🍕🇮🇹🍝!

I had a great time at the Ci Tua! It was nice surprise after a walk in Nothing Hill. It’s as small place but gigantic in care and food quality. The people are friendly and the food delicious! If you want real Italian food when in London, I sure recommend this place! I’m always a bit doubtful about having tiramisu out of Italy, but since the whole team is Italian, I felt like I was in Rome!

Ci Tua in Portobello is a hidden gem that delivers a truly authentic Italian experience. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, with friendly staff who make you feel right at home. The highlight of my meal was the Carbonara—without a doubt, the best I’ve ever had! Perfectly creamy, rich, and made the traditional way without cream, just how it should be. The pasta was cooked to perfection, and the balance of flavors was outstanding.

The rest of the menu offers equally delicious options, with fresh ingredients and excellent presentation. Service was attentive, though slightly slow at peak hours. Overall, an incredible dining experience. Can’t wait to return!

places.name: Caractère
places.formatted_address: 209 Westbourne Park Rd, London W11 1EA, UK

reviews.text: A truly special place. The food was phenomenal and consistent with every course impressing us with both flavour and presentation. The setting and ambience is pitched just right without being stuffy. The service was a cut above, with everyone being friendly and super attentive. We went for the tasting menu at dinner time and would recommend a thousand times over for a special occasion.

I have visited the restaurant to celebrate my husband’s birthday and I was blown away by the service and the taste of the food. Every single dishes that we have had was spectacular. I love every bite. I would definitely come back again and highly recommend this place to anyone who is considering. You won’t regret it.
Magnificent experience, incredible food and so much inspiration! Every dish was a piece of art! Looking forward to be back for the tasting menu with the wine pairing!

Beautiful, fragrant, and delicious. 5 stars, no doubt. I tried their 5-course tasting menu, and diners had a choice of 2 for each course. I don't have any food allergies, but sometimes I do have preferences. To be able to present a tasting menu with flexibility and options was something I felt more amazing about the chef's menu design. My favourite was the pigeon, and I was so happy to see that the chef took on the challenge to turn the pigeon leg into a piece of fine "finger" food.

Ingredients were top-notch. Culinary skills were clearly showcased. Menu cleverly designed. Options available to suit any appetite. Comfy dining environment. Happy stomach, happy me.

Every aspect of my evening with the team at caractère was exceptional and exceeded my lofty expectations. It's not often when I have no constructive feedback for a team, but I'm very comfortable in stating this was as perfect an experience as is humanly possible.

Arriving just a few minutes earlier than my reservation, I was the first guest to arrive for dinner. While oftentimes this is an opportunity for one to witness last-minute preparations - not at caractère - the team was ready.

Greeted warmly and shown to a corner table that overlooked the entire comfortable space that feels more homey than commercial, I was able to observe the entire orchestra of service perform their beautiful symphony of caring for their guests. Opting for the tasting menu, and adding their focus special that included seasonally fresh black truffle, the sommelier asked about my choice for wine - I opted to leave it to him for pairing each of the 6 courses. This one decision proved to be wise.

The details are seen in the included pictures: generous portions, insanely creative presentations of each plate, attention to detail of adornments, exquisite timing (6 courses = 3 hours).

And the wine... provocative and foundational selections. Sensory perfection. Each was offered with a level of education, reasoning and pairing decision-making.

One star? I would offer there is some room for recognition improvement...

places.name: La mia Mamma Notting Hill
places.formatted_address: 190 Kensington Park Rd, London W11 2ES, UK

reviews.text: Absolutely perfect meal. Delicious food - do yourself a favor and order the mixed starters. Fresh and flavorful pasta. Great value. Five star service. Beautiful restaurant from top to bottom. We’ve tried every Italian restaurant on the street and this may now be our favorite. Can’t recommend La mia Mamma enough!

The evening was a real pleasure from start to finish. The food came out beautifully presented and full of flavour, each dish clearly made with care and attention. You could taste the freshness of the ingredients, and the variety gave the dish a wonderful balance. What made the experience even better was the service. Our waitress (Romeo) was truly wonderful, attentive without ever being intrusive, and he made sure we were comfortable throughout. The chef deserves just as much praise, as every plate was perfectly seasoned and full of character. La mia mamma was so kind and welcoming, which made the whole atmosphere feel warm and personal, almost like dining with family. This combination of genuine hospitality and excellent cooking made the evening memorable.

Fabio took care of us and was fantastic, all the food we had was delicious and so well done. You feel like you’re transported to a Nona’s home, the pasta was so comforting and the tiramisu was delightful. Would recommend and will definitely be back to try the rest of the menu!

I was looking for an authentic Italian restaurant and La Mia clearly meets the criteria. The pizza was amazing ( tasted similar to the ones I had in Italy) - I ordered tomato basil pizza with additional- artichoke ,olive and onion toppings. Pasta was a white sauce one which I found just okay but my parents liked it . They gave us a complimentary plate of bruschetta which was really nice of them . For dessert , we ordered tiramisu which was also quite delicious. The portions were huge and quite filling. We paid 50£ in total for all of the above which wasn’t bad for a filing lunch between 3 people. Not to forget, this place gets busy and you may need to book in advance . The staff was very kind to have accommodated us even without a booking. Great service . Will come again for sure.

The food was good. I tried the all-you-can-eat pasta meal. It was nice, though I'm not a huge pasta fan, so my opinion might not be the most valid. I wouldn't get that again, as it was a birthday and a set menu. I probably wouldn't have picked certain dishes. But if you love pasta and cheese, this is for you. And the service was second to none; the staff were very attentive.

places.name: Dove Restaurant
places.formatted_address: 31 Kensington Park Rd, London W11 2EU, UK
places.editorial_summary: Elegant spot with wood & brick decor, with a focus on fish & seafood inspired by the Western Isles.

reviews.text:
I was keen to try the famous 10-per-day burger. Made the reservation for midday, when they open, but arrived at 11:45 and sat outside. A queue formed around me, and it definitely consisted of more than 10 people.

All staff members I encountered were so friendly and helpful. Really impressed me, from front of house to wait staff.

Beautiful environment, I liked the calming colour scheme and decor very much. Comfortable seating, and nice bathrooms also.

I did manage to get the burger (which I overheard had sold out, and when I checked my watch it was 12:08pm!) and it was really good. Simple, quality, wholesome. It was juicy, and so messy to eat. So flavoursome. Had no idea how to eat it so I made a right mess of it, but no shame here. I can’t bring myself to call it the best burger I’ve ever eaten; something is holding me back from that, but I can’t tell you what. Because I ate quite slowly, maybe it was that the lightly toasted bun dried out a little by the time I ate the second half.

I ordered a side of fries, this was a step too far for me. I would have been satisfied without these, I’m not sure if my appetite is small or normal though so I speak for myself. The fries were really good, but quite expensive compared to the burger.

Bill came to £36, this included - burger, fries, still water, a fresh lemon iced tea and service charge.

On a Sunday the street parking is free. I found a space a few minutes / short walk away. I imagine on all other days it’s either expensive or tricky to find a space.

I am a big foodie and bar seeker when on holiday.  Saw Doves burger that they only make 10 of per day online and made a reservation for when they open at 5:30. Let me say it did NOT disappoint.  My boyfriend and i agree that was the best burger we have ever had.  We also had an appetizer that was like a mini pizza that was delicious.  Staff completely friendly and fast service.  Def a must when you visit London.
Fantastic birthday dinner for my wife in the private dining room! Food was delicious and certainly best burger in London! Excellent wines and very reasonably priced. Can't wait to book again!

Food is overpriced for the size, and it is stupid to have the burger be so limited in terms of availability. The service was good and could meet wishes about diary allergies. Their general layout of doing the food downstairs and the dishes next to the guests is very disturbing. As marked on the photo, I literally sat next to the staff doing the dishes, - and was consequentially splashed by liquids from a dirty dishwasher. Very bad.
Went for Sunday lunch and it was all flawless. Brilliant, diligent and friendly service from Sammy, incredible food and flavours. Gorgeous big table under the skylight. 100% recommend!

places.name: Taqueria - Notting Hill
places.editorial_summary: Tacos & Mexican street food small plates, plus margaritas & blue agave tequilas.

reviews.text: Friendly staff, delicious tacos and cocktails. A true margarita paradise, with the pisco sour being top-notch. On Friday evening there was live music, which made the atmosphere really warm and soulful. Highly recommend!

A Hidden Gem in Notting Hill. We Didn’t Know We Needed This!

My group of friends and I were wandering around Notting Hill recently, not really sure where to grab a bite. Honestly, we hadn't heard of Taquería before, we actually came across it online while walking nearby. It looked close and promising, so on a bit of a whim (and with some help from a little AI suggestion), we decided to give it a shot.

And wow, what a fantastic decision it turned out to be!

From the moment we walked in, we were impressed. The place is just as good in person as it looks in photos, vibrant, cozy, and full of character. It instantly felt welcoming, which was made even better by the absolutely amazing staff who treated us like old friends. They were warm, attentive, and always checking in to make sure we were enjoying everything, it really elevated the whole experience.

Now, onto the food: this is the real deal when it comes to authentic Mexican cuisine. The tacos were bursting with flavor, tender meat, fresh toppings, and warm tortillas that tasted homemade. The nachos were a highlight too; crispy, cheesy, and perfectly seasoned. And the drinks? So refreshing! We tried a few different options, and each one was delicious and well-made.

Beyond the food, we genuinely had a lot of fun here. It’s the kind of place that feels like a little escape, great vibes, great people, and great flavors. You can tell they put love into every part of the experience.

I can’t recommend Taquería enough. Whether you're a local or just passing through Notting Hill, do yourself a favor and stop by. We’ll definitely be back, next time maybe with more friends (and less wandering)

Staff was very friendly and gave quick service. The food was delicious and great value for money. Would definitely recommend order a variety of plates to share so you can try everything.They had a range of vegetarian/vegan options too.

tacos sooo tasty.. tho please some more vegan options this is very important!! the churros apparently tasted like a kit kat (5*) the little cocktail stand kept falling over and i appreciated how they had a barcode to go straight to the reviewing

Its a lovely restaurant with a Mexican Cuisine! It’s not too big or too small. We were greeted with a smile and the staff was very accommodating ~ and always tending to us! The food was amazing! We loved everything. I really recommend the fried Calamari and the Pork/Pineapple tacos! Also the drinks were delightful! We got the “Piñata” and it was amazing! Really really recommend!

places.name: Andy’s Greek Taverna
places.editorial_summary: Whitewashed taverna with a rustic style and beamed ceilings, serving classical Greek dishes.

reviews.text:
Lively Greek restaurant with indoor and outdoor seating. Authentic and varied menu, good options for vegetarians.

The food was all delicious - you can taste the olive oil and lemon, and it was freshly prepared.

The service was very good, and they don’t rush you. They were helpful and friendly.

I would return to try other things on the menu!

They have set menus as well which seem good.

We went here for a cross-generational family lunch on a Sunday and we had a great time. The food was delicious and everyone in our party was very happy. The staff were friendly and helpful and the prices were very reasonable for the area. Definitely recommended! Reserve a table.

wonderful restaurant! a popular spot in the neighborhood but not touristy. been here a few times in the last year and it’s great every time. service is wonderful and the employees are very nice. they give you a shot of amaretto at the end too. seafood is delicious.

Visited for my daughter's birthday meal and was pleased with the whole experience.
The staff are really welcoming and make you feel like family, the food is   great and the atmosphere makes you feel like you're on holiday.
All in all, it's great value for money and an experience we'll definitely be repeating.
Great food, very reasonable prices. The mixed grill was delicious. The owner is also very friendly, and gave us a round of shots on the house! Great option for a non touristy restaurant in Camden.

places.name: The Blues Kitchen Camden
places.formatted_address: 111-113 Camden High St, London NW1 7JN, UK
places.editorial_summary: Dedicated blues bar serving hickory-smoked comfort food, plus regular live music & DJs.

reviews.text:
I was welcomed by the lovely girl named Helen who searched for a table for me and seated me while I was still waiting for my partner.
The atmosphere was amazing, great vibe and music.
The decor is very cool and unique even inside the rest rooms.
The food was good.
We had two burgers- vegan and beef with extra bacon.
My vegan one was good but could have had more vegetables inside. It was just like piece of salad and pickle. Could be something more.
In general very good experience.
The staff was great, we were looked after.
Thanks .

Food was delicious 😋 enjoyed the tuna starter & squid. Unfortunately the chicken wings were dry for me. We had burgers as mains, nice portion took some home. The dessert was a  dark chocolate ganache with honeycomb. Strangely served in a drinking glass - nice, rich but small portion.
Venue was gorgeous inside, unfortunately not enough staff, despite going up to pay I was told I had to await a server - that took age's!!.
As part of First table.

First time coming here, but definitely won’t be my last. The food was absolutely DELICIOUS and affordable prices, and had a live band. I got the chicken burger with mac and cheese and it was definitely a hit! 😍😍I went on Tuesday and was able to get the £6 Tuesday tequila and tried margarita for the first time😍. I want to also thank my lovely waitress Sadie, I believe she said she was new, but she was  the BEST host all night and made sure we were taken care of every time. She made us try the lovely Oreo doughnuts which is DIE for. She has also made me a tequila fan from her recommendations. I will definitely be visiting again and hope to see Sadie’s lovely smile. Thank you for making my anniversary more enjoyable🤩

Came for late lunch, seated after a little wait at the bar,  by a smiley host, staff having a laugh but attentive to us and other tables around. Food was great for all of us, pretty much had everything on the menu for the 5 of us.

Rounds of Guinness came in constantly, just what we love.

Been before, will come again next weekend, see you soon Mattie, best server this side of the river!

Great vibes, amazing live music, and delicious food! The atmosphere is lively yet relaxed, perfect for a night out. The staff were super friendly and the cocktails were spot on. Definitely a Camden gem! will be back!

The place was nice and atmosphere was great.
My pasta with salmon was tasty and portion was big.
The service was very good and helpful.
Some of the best Italian food I have had in London, lovely staff, great service, very great vibe inside. Lasagna was amazing, fair portions and fanstastic cocktails!!!! Couldn’t recommend it more!
The staff is friendly and attentive. While the dishes were pleasant enough, they lacked the vibrant flavors and authentic character I'd expect from Italian cuisine. Generous portions and good prices.

Authentic and delicious! My friends and I had booked Il Sugo as we had a day planned throughout London. We didn't really know what to expect, but we left feeling delighted! (and very full) The portions are very generous and the waitress who served us was attentive and lovely. The service was pretty quick too and great prices.
second visit well worth it. good portion size for normal london prices. friendly staff too

places.name: Laz @Camden
places.editorial_summary: Brick-lined walls & mid-century lighting in a relaxed setting with Turkish small & shared plates.

reviews.text:
We visited Laz in Camden and, at first, everything seemed lovely. The restaurant itself is small, warm, and very welcoming. The environment feels cosy and inviting, the mezes and sides were delicious, the drinks were great, and the live music was okay — it added a nice atmosphere to the evening.
However, our experience was unfortunately spoiled by the service. The older waiter kept coming back and forth to our table, repeatedly trying to push us to order more food even though we already had plenty of mezes and sides. He told us that if we didn’t order mains, we would be charged £50 per person — something that wasn’t mentioned anywhere on the menu or by anyone else.
In the end, they didn’t actually charge us that amount, so it was clearly false information used to pressure us into ordering more. This made us feel uncomfortable and unwelcome, and we decided to leave.
It’s a shame, because the food and atmosphere were both really nice, but the service left a very negative impression.

I love this place! It’s the first time I come here and I have to say it’s a bit different compared to other Turkish restaurants and also a bit expensive however worth every penny! The food was so delicious, the staff, the ambience there also was live music! We had such a beautiful evening I would highly recommend to anyone wanting to try authentic Turkish experience in London and I am sure I will go back again!!!

Incredible food! Accompanied by excellent service.

Ayse, was our waitress who could not do enough for us. My family and I were spoiled for choice on cuisine.

We attended on a busy Saturday afternoon, but service was quick. I cannot recommend highly enough.
Had a fabulous meal there on Saturday evening.  Food was delicious and looked awesome.  A very attractive venue with some live music. Very friendly staff. Superb atmosphere.

Went to Laz for my partners birthday and had an Absolutely amazing time.

The food was delicious, the portions were great and the service was exceptionally outstanding. Thank you to the team that catered to our every need. The service was so fast considering it was full house. The live music was a lovely touch.

Would definitely recommend and we will be returning very soon.

places.name: Daphne Restaurant
places.formatted_address: 83 Bayham St, Greater, London NW1 0AG, UK
places.editorial_summary: Polished, long-running haunt adorned with photography & traditional decor executing Greek recipes.

reviews.text:
The food was AMAZING!! Tasted and felt very authentic, from the meze to the mains and the lovely Greek service.

Taramasalata is a MUST — best we’ve ever had. Had the lamb chops and was delicious!

Only thing is it’s a small place so can get cramped and a bit loud. However still a great place to go for special occasions or any occasion really!
Great 2 course lunch special for £15. The mixed dips you can choose how ever many you want (fits a small plate). The meat moussaka was great.

Seems extreme to label all 5⭐️s but I had no plans to come here. I was meant to go across the street to another restaurant where I had a booking, peeked in here on the way over & ditched all plans. The food was phenomenal. I had a lamb shank which melted off the bone. We had a seafood starter and the haloumin which was grand. Nicholas was a gem. One of my fave nights in my new neighbourhood. 100% RECOMMEND!

Superior food and service. This restaurant is 5 stars plus! The shrimp appetizer, grilled swordfish steak special and Greek salad were all perfectly prepared and delicious! Such a great find in Camden that I asked for a reservation the next night as well.
Amazing food!!! Very authentic. I lived in Cyprus for many years and just took me back to my happy place.

places.name: La Patagonia
places.formatted_address: 31 Camden High St, London NW1 7JE, UK
places.editorial_summary: Exposed-brick, barrio-style setting featuring hearty homestyle Argentinian cuisine.

reviews.text: This is such a hidden gem in Camden. The restaurant is very intimate which makes it perfect for date night. We had a party of 6 and all of our food came out just the way we ordered. All the Steak was cooked to perfection. The waiter was extremely attentive. Highly recommend.

Went here on a Saturday. My friend chose the place and I generally like Argentinian.

First, service was exemplary. Especially with my friend’s daughter. Lovely chap.

Onto the food.

Chicken Empanadas - not bad. OK portion size.

Ribeye steak - not bad. Reasonably well cooked. Flavour a bit lacking.

Lomo - the fillet steak that just tasted average. The peppercorn sauce was decent.

Fries - good, can’t mess these up really.

Creamed spinach - bland. Didn’t really enjoy it. Need more flavour, herbs.

Overall it was…not bad. That is to say, not good either. Rather pricey given the quality.

Would I return? No.

What a great place to eat, we were a party of 4 and one of out party was from Argentina so I wanted an authentic experience which we got! The owner has their own range of Malbec which goes superbly with the various cuts of meat cooked to perfection!  If you love steak, you definitely have to visit this place!

It was a random find in the "taste for all" Camden town. The venue did not disappoint. Atmosphere was chill, argentinian themed. Staff was corteous, present but not overwhelming, accomodating, smiling and giving advice as requested. Food was tasty, arrived hot and on time. Tasty, everyone enjoyed their choices. Excellent place worth repeating.

Excellent quality restaurant with good service and even better dishes. Popular on a Friday evening with people walking in trying to get a table so booking is recommended. The table service is enthusiastic without being overbearing, it's easy to get attention for another round of drinks. It's a mainly meat menu (that shouldn't come as a surprise) with my dish being well cooked (medium rare), well presented, and tender to cut and eat. There are home made pasta options as well if meat is not your thing. There is also a good selection of Argentinian wines and beer to compliment the dishes. So whole heartily recommended.

Amazing experience nicest turtle bay I’ve been to! Food came so fast and was so yummy. The cocktails kept flowing our host Olivia was so on it!! So friendly already planning my next visit hope to get Olivia serving us again!

I left yesterday feeling a little disappointed with my experience here. I had brought my friends here thinking it was going to be a good dinner however I was a bit let down by some of the meals brought to us. One of my friends food choice was cold when brought to her, my friends ordered lemonade and all our drinks came but theirs so they had to go up to realise their drinks were left on the side and when they had it, of course it was flat. Smashed burger was a little dry and the wings were more bones than actual meat. The restaurant itself was quite pretty inside and location wise ideal but sadly food was not.

Came here for a bottomless brunch twice now and had a great time both times. The variety of food is good and portions are filling. Lots of drinks choices and all prepared in a timely manner. Staff are always nice.

I am quite disappointed with the food from here! The starters were delicious and the cocktails were really tasty we had a 2-4-1 offer on so got to try out a few different cocktails but the mains were really lacking in flavour.
One of my best turtle bay experiences to date. The waitress was so lovely and a vibe which made the experience better. The food was immaculate, I’m still in shock by how great it was.

places.name: Jamon Jamon
places.editorial_summary: Classic tapas, paella & sangria served in a contemporary dining room with wooden tables.

reviews.text:
We had a fantastic experience at Jamon Jamon Camden! The tapas were delicious, the chorizo and chicken paella was perfectly cooked. The staff was incredibly welcoming, and a special mention to the new manager, Isa, who gave us great recommendations and made us feel at home.

If you love authentic Spanish food with excellent service, this is the place to go!

Staff were nice enough and did came out in a timely way, it was hot. Had 5 plates, 2 were good the others were OK. The bravas is best described as small cubed fries with two sauces on the side. At nearly £7..well...so I would say the food was average compared to other Spanish tapas I have had at this price point. No major complaints but first visit for 5 plates and that will be my only visit.

My interest in visiting this place was because I saw that Amy Winehouse loved to eat there.
That's why I went there and I eat Spanish food (I had already tried Spanish food when I was in Barcelona and Madrid).
So this place is very nice, the atmosphere, the food, the service and the music and it’s close to the bus station, metro, pubs, etc. I love it.

I thoroughly enjoyed the delectable dishes at the restaurant.

The culinary experience was exceptional as we indulged in a variety of items

1.  gamas
2. Chorizo
3. Paella with seafood,
4. paella with ink,
5. calamari.

Each dish left a lasting impression with its incredible flavors, making the overall dining experience immensely satisfying.

The service and ambiance added to the positive experience; everything was simply outstanding, leaving no room for complaints. The staff provided excellent service, contributing to the overall pleasant vibe of the place.

Tip: Reserve to dine at Soho for a delightful experience.

We chanced upon this when we were looking for a place to eat. And we are really glad we did. The food is good. And the restaurant feels airy and inviting. I particularly like the natural daylight coming through the glass roof. The mushrooms and the prawns are highly recommended.

places.name: Purezza Camden
places.editorial_summary: Easygoing place offering a range of vegan sourdough pizza, salads, raw dishes, pasta & desserts.

reviews.text:
We had the Black Truffle Pizza and the Parmigiana Party — both were sooo flavourful and perfectly seasoned! The vegan cheese made the pizzas super creamy and delicious. The dough was soft with a little chew, just right for that perfect crust texture. 🍕✨

I love how they use the real pizza oven — makes everything taste so fresh and amazing. The vibe in the restaurant is really good too.

Honestly, this is the BEST pizza I’ve ever had in my life 🙌 whether you’re vegan or not, you gotta try it. I’d definitely go back again!

I’m Italian, and I can say with absolute certainty it’s one of the best pizzas I’ve ever eaten. The taste is just like a real, authentic one, yet it’s completely plant-based. They offer different types of dough, and the sourdough is incredibly delicious, light, tasty, and it leaves you feeling great, without any bloating.

The staff are very nice, friendly, and professional. I had the pizza Parmigiana and the tiramisù, and both were absolutely mouth-watering. I only wish I could stay longer in London to go back there again!

If you’re looking for the best vegan Neapolitan pizza in London, this is the place to be! Warm and welcoming atmosphere that makes you feel right at home. The pizza is soft, flavorful, and made with the freshest ingredients — a true hug of taste in every bite. Perfect for a friendly evening out with friends!
Try pistachio and parmesana!

TL;DR: I liked it! Not all my friends did.

1. If you are not used to vegan pizza, you might find it quite different from the classic one (e.g. the cheese didn't taste like the standard counterpart)
2. The standard wholemeal dough was really good 😋
3. We really didn't like the gluten-free one ❌
4. We liked the parmigiana pizza and the veggie, but not the margherita 😢
5. We liked the starters (parmigiana and meatballs)
6. The service was really great: Greg was very helpful and kind, and he even offered to take the gluten-free pizza off the bill when we complained about it

Joe was our server and was very helpful with recommending toppings for my pizza and service was so friendly and welcoming, the food was also very delicious as were desserts. Definitely will come back. Thank you !!

places.name: Frida Camden
places.formatted_address: 40 Camden High St, London NW1 0JH, UK
places.editorial_summary: Mexican & Spanish cuisine in a rustic, cantina-style space with colorful chairs & patterned tiles.

reviews.text:
Frida Camden is an absolute gem for anyone craving authentic Mexican cuisine. The flavors are bold yet balanced, with every dish feeling like it’s made with care and tradition. The menu celebrates the richness of Mexican food while keeping everything fresh and vibrant, making each bite a real treat. Whether you’re indulging in tacos, enchiladas, or one of their specialties, the food feels both comforting and exciting—easily some of the best Mexican fare around.

What truly sets Frida Camden apart is their salsa. It’s not just a side—it’s an experience on its own. The traditional recipe bursts with freshness, the right amount of spice, and that homemade touch that’s hard to find elsewhere. Paired with warm, crisp tortilla chips, it’s the perfect way to start a meal and sets the tone for the flavorful journey ahead. For those who love genuine Mexican flavors, this spot is a must-visit.

I passed by Frida one month ago. I was attracted by its decoration. Today my friend asked me do you have any new restaurant want to explore? I said I have one! So we are here! We ordered spicy beef nachos and Chicken Fajitas , passion fruit and mango Margaritas! Absolutely delicious!!!! I highly recommend!

Table for 5 booked for 5pm on a Saturday evening. It wasn't too busy when we arrived and they were expecting our arrival which was nice.
Service was great and food arrived promptly. Good vegan and veggie options too. We really enjoyed the experienceand we left full. We're looking forward to coming back here. It might be our new favourite place in Camden
Overall the experience at Frida was average. Not bad but just not great either. The food was okay but over priced for what it was

We came here for breakfast on a recent trip to Camden as the other cafes were busy, I'm glad we did as the food and service were very good. The young lady waiting on our table was very polite and efficient. There was a good choice of food for both meat eaters and vegetarians.

places.name: Band of Burgers, Camden
places.formatted_address: 23 Camden High St, London NW1 7JE, UK
places.editorial_summary: Local chain grilling burgers on charcoal and serving them with cocktails, fresh juices and shakes.

reviews.text: Surprised at how quiet it was. 5 of us popped in for their lunch deal, it was dead. Waitress had 'popped to the shop' so a slight delay in ordering, but other than that it's a great value for money lunch, given it's location. £11.99 for a choice of burger, chips and a can.

So, I was looking for a quick bite to eat before a gig over the road at KOKO.
Found this little place, on arrival it looked great from outside and in. I stood at the front of the restaurant and waited for a while, even though there was a lady cleaning a table infront of me and the place had lots of spare seats. I had to ask her if I could sit down, and she wasn't too friendly either.

Onto the food, I had burger, chips and squid.
All of the food was delicious, hot and flavoursome. The food didn't takelong to come out.
The service was disappointing and then to be hit with a service charge was a kick in the teeth. Hence the 3 star review.
Customer service is huge, definitely needs looking at.

All food we ordered was delicious, service was good. Shame they don't serve alcohol, but they did say you can bring your own.
Staff are friendly and polite.
The tortilla chips used for nachos were really good, different to the standard ones we get here. Coleslaw was tasty. Sweet potato fries were lovely a crispy. I had the Mexican chicken burger, was really good.
My friend had beef burger, which he said was good.
We did order too much food, but you can take leftovers home!
Good value lunch deal for a burger, fries & drink. The burger and fries were great. Ordered wings as well which were average. Good portions overall. Good service.

Came in here on a whim on a Sunday evening just before a gig. One of the best burgers I've EVER had. The meat was perfectly cooked, it was so juicy and fully of flavour! The portions of fries were very generous and the milkshakes were delicious - ice cold and with a healthy amount of whipped cream on top! Definitely will come back here when I'm in Camden and need a bite 👍

places.name: Made in Brasil
places.editorial_summary: Brazilian and Latino cuisine in colourful beach shack-style restaurant and bar with live music.

reviews.text: Food was delicious, especially the deserts WOW did they taste so frickin good let alone looked just as good as they tasted. Food was taste I think they could have gone less on the cress for presentation didn’t needs so much green grass but it all tasted beautifully. Cocktails were nice. Would highly recommend the bottomless brunch.
Fantastic place! Friendly, welcoming staff, amazing drinks, and food that’s simply out of this world – fresh, flavorful, and top quality. Can’t wait to come back!

We had a mixed experience. My partners food was great. Well cooked and full of flavour. Mine was dry and overcooked. Also they replaced our beans, when one of the waiters noticed it didn’t look right (why they served it to begin with, I dont know).

It should be noticed I’m a “gringo” in these places, but my partner is Brasilian and it was clear, “locals” get special treatment and better service.

Also very expensive! Use Fork or some other discount app!

Made in Brasil in Camden brings a lively slice of Rio straight into the heart of London. The atmosphere is vibrant and colorful, with samba rhythms, warm lighting, and a menu bursting with authentic Brazilian flavors. From feijoada and picanha to creative small plates, the food feels both hearty and festive, while the cocktail list—especially the caipirinhas—is a highlight that adds to the fun, easygoing vibe.

The restaurant balances energy with comfort, making it just as good for a casual night out with friends as it is for a celebratory dinner. Service is friendly and relaxed, and while it can get busy in the evenings, that only adds to the buzz that makes Camden dining unique. Altogether, Made in Brasil delivers a genuine taste of Brazil with an atmosphere that’s hard not to get swept up in.
