I had lunch with a friend on a Tuesday at this charming Brazilian restaurant in lively Camden and it was a fantastic experience from start to finish.

From the moment we arrived, the warm and welcoming staff made us feel at home. Despite the restaurant being busy, the service was attentive and engaging, with friendly interactions that added to the overall experience. The interior was richly cultural and inviting, creating a perfect setting for a relaxed meal.

The menu offered a great variety of options, and we especially enjoyed their starters and tapas-style dishes, which were full of bold and exciting flavors. While I can’t speak to how authentic the food is, it was definitely delicious and satisfying.

To top it off, we booked through The Fork and received a wonderful discount, which was applied smoothly with no issues.

Overall, it was a delightful dining experience and I’d highly recommend this place for anyone looking to enjoy a flavourful and welcoming atmosphere in Camden.

places.name: COCO Canary Wharf - Restaurant & Lounge
places.formatted_address: West India Quay, 14 Hertsmere Rd, London E14 4AF, UK
places.vicinity: West India Quay, 14 Hertsmere Rd, London

reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at COCO in Canary Wharf. From the moment we walked in, everything felt spotless and welcoming ! the place was absolutely clean and beautifully maintained. The service was truly five-star: attentive, friendly, and professional. We never felt like anything was missing, because everything we could possibly need was already taken care of.

It’s rare to find a restaurant where cleanliness, atmosphere, and service all come together so perfectly, but this one really exceeded my expectations. I left genuinely impressed and very happy with the whole experience. Definitely a place I would recommend to anyone visiting Canary Wharf!

Had such a great night at Coco Shisha in Canary Wharf! 🔥

The staff were super friendly, especially Naz and Tutul – they were amazing at helping us choose dishes and made the whole experience smooth and fun

We had the lamb chops, and honestly… wow.
So juicy, tender and packed with flavour – highly recommend!

Tried the *Sunrise Glow* drink too – it's a refreshing, alcohol-free twist on a spritz 🍹✨ Perfect if you're skipping booze but still want something fun.

And the shisha? Absolutely on point 💨 — smooth, flavourful, and beautifully presented. Definitely one of the best in London.

Great vibes, great people, great food — can’t wait to go back!

Had such a cute and relaxing evening at Coco in Canary Wharf! The place has a really nice atmosphere — chilled but still stylish, perfect for an evening out with friends 💫

A huge thank you to Naz and Tutul who were so lovely and helpful! They guided us through the menu and made some great suggestions 💕

I tried the *chicken bao* and it was so delicious — soft, flavourful and just the right amount of spice. And don’t even get me started on the cheesecake… light, creamy and honestly the perfect dessert 🍰✨

For drinks, I went with the Sunrise Glow — it’s a non-alcoholic spritz and it was so refreshing and pretty! Loved that there’s a fun alcohol-free option that still feels special 🍹

We also had shisha and it was amazing — smooth, full of flavour, and beautifully presented 💨

Food is quite excellent here. Starters were much more impressive than the main courses but overall there is not a single dish that we disliked. The restaurant is alcoholic free but their mocktail/“cocktails” still tasted pretty great and they do provide nonalcoholic wine. Service wise they were quite attentive, staff members are very friendly especially our server NUMAN, ADNAN TSURV. Atmosphere wise the restaurant is quite nicely decorated in the indoor area.

We had the most beautiful lunch at Coco Grill. The seabass with the creamy, decadent mash potatoes and the blackcurrant halloumi were my favourite dishes - everything was so beautifully presented. The service was excellent, all the staff were so friendly and helpful - it added to our experience. The mocktails were incredible, possibly the best mocktails I’ve ever had. So yummy. Everything was incredible, thank you to the team!

places.name: Brother Marcus Canary Wharf
places.formatted_address: YY Building, Reuters Plaza, London E14 5HX, UK

reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience at Brother Marcus Canary Wharf. The food was outstanding – fresh, high-quality ingredients, full of flavour and beautifully presented. What really made the visit exceptional was the service. Lisa was amazing – warm, attentive, and genuinely passionate about making sure everything was perfect. A restaurant that truly delivers on both food and service.

I really liked Brother Marcus!
The staff were really lovely. We asked for Marcus's Choice, and the experience was great. Food kept coming, so we were both so full, and they kept asking if we wanted more or anything specific.
The food was all delicious, I'd especially recommend the aubergine because I've never had them cooked like that before.
I'd definitely recommend!

This place is great for dinner. The atmosphere is lovely. Soheil was very friendly and gave us recommendations. The food was really good, good portion, very delicious - I would recommend the rips & dips and the crispy aubergine skewer. Definitely will come back

Stumbled upon this incredible spot by chance and what an unforgettable experience!
The food was an absolute 10/10. Brunch and dessert were both outstanding some of the best I’ve had. If I’d had the time, I would’ve come back the very next day, even just for dessert.
The service was exceptional truly faultless. A huge thank you to Ivan, Anna, Ada, and Danielle for making it so special. I’ll definitely be returning!

Absolutely fantastic experience! From the moment I walked in, the warm, inviting atmosphere made me feel right at home. The staff were friendly and attentive, providing excellent service without being overbearing.

The menu  offers a wonderful mix of Mediterranean-inspired dishes, with something for everyone, whether you're a meat lover or a vegetarian.

The atmosphere is vibrant yet laid-back, making it perfect for a casual dinner with friends or a more intimate date night. Whether you're after a relaxing meal or a lively night out, this place truly has it all.

Overall, I can’t recommend Brother Marcus enough—wonderful food, excellent service, and a fantastic vibe. I’ll definitely be back!

places.name: The Ivy Canary Wharf
places.formatted_address: 50 Canada Square Park, London E14 5FW, UK
places.vicinity: 50 Canada Square Park, Canary Wharf, London
places.editorial_summary: Modern British menus served in a refined, art-filled space with a garden terrace and an orangery.

reviews.text:
The restaurant is beautifully decorated with a stylish and elegant atmosphere, perfect for both gatherings and special occasions. The food was quite good overall. The ice cream with mixed berries was refreshing, though the berries themselves were quite sour. The shepherd’s pie was flavorful and satisfying, definitely a highlight of the meal. The pumpkin soup had a rich and creamy taste, very enjoyable.

A lovely dining experience with great ambiance and good food.

We (my wife and I) visited this restaurant at about 9.30 on a Saturday morning and it was very quiet so difficult to gauge atmosphere.  The decor of the restaurant was lovely although some of the furniture was starting to show signs of wear and tear. The staff were all lovely and the food was good and less expensive than one might think for such a location.  I felt the sausage and the black pudding lacked some seasoning although I appreciate that's personal taste and others would find them ok. All in all a good breakfast experience although I probably wouldn't rush back for breakfast.

I had such an amazing time at Ivy Restaurant last night! From start to finish, everything was just perfect. The Tempura Prawns were super crispy and full of flavour, and the Moroccan Chicken was honestly one of the best dishes I’ve had in a long time — so juicy and well seasoned!

The ambience was lovely too — I really liked the cosy yet elegant décor, which made the whole place feel welcoming and special. It’s the kind of spot where you can relax, enjoy your meal, and just have a good time.

A big shoutout to Osman for his excellent service! He was so attentive, had great timing, and really made us laugh throughout the evening. It’s rare to find staff who make the experience feel so personal and fun.

Overall, I’d definitely recommend Ivy to anyone looking for great food, a lovely atmosphere, and friendly service. Can’t wait to go back!

I had an absolutely wonderful experience at The Ivy! The venue is simply gorgeous, with a chic and elegant atmosphere that makes you feel special the moment you walk in. Our server, Alfie, was incredibly attentive and polite, ensuring every detail of our evening was perfect. The food was nothing short of amazing—each dish was beautifully presented and bursting with flavor, though it is on the pricier side. The restaurant is impeccably organized, making the entire dining experience seamless and enjoyable. I had an amazing time and am already looking forward to my next visit! Highly recommend!

Had a lovely dining experience at The Ivy Canary Wharf.
The food was delicious and beautifully presented, with a great selection on the menu.

The atmosphere was elegant yet relaxed, and the location is perfect — especially convenient as it’s close to home.

Prices are on the higher side, but the quality of food, service, and overall experience make it feel worth the occasional treat.

Perfect spot for a nice dinner or special occasion. ✨🍽️

places.name: Barbarella
places.formatted_address: Mackenzie Walk Unit 3 YY, London E14 5HX, UK

reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant. First week of opening but you wouldn’t have known as everything was so slick. Food was some of the best I’ve ever had. Highly recommend

Such a great spot! The pizza crust was crispy and light, the pasta was packed with flavor, and everything tasted so fresh. The staff were friendly and made great recommendations. You can tell they really care about quality here. Five stars all the way!

A different Italian!
My husband booked this place for my birthday dinner. He kept it as a surprise. The restaurant is within few metres of Canary Wharf tube station.
Upon arrival we received a warm welcome. I received a birthday card signed by the squad of the restaurant. That was quite unique. I liked it!
The interior is impressive, nice decor and the lights - all give it a posh look.
For starter we ordered normal bread and garlic bread. With the first bite of each, I felt like it's completely different than any of them I have ever tasted. It was so good!
For the mains, my first choice was not available, hence I went with the sea bass option "Branzino in Guazzetto". I was sceptical with the thought of tomato sauce being too tangy. When it arrived and I took the first taste, I felt like I have never tasted a sauce like that before. It was tastebud-awakening! So delicious!
My husband had the pizza "Some Like It Hot", that was quite different tasting as well. It was slightly on hot side as it says.
They don't have a kids menu but we went with the recommended one "Spaghettoni al Ragù di Agnellowhich". It was perfect for the little one.
For the dessert we went for Creme Brulee, that came with a candle on top 😊
The service was superb throughout.
Altogether it was an amazing dining experience and a perfect birthday meal! Thank you!

I had a wonderful experience at Barbarella restaurant. From the moment we arrived, the staff gave us a very warm welcome and made us feel comfortable. They also gave us good recommendations from the menu, which helped us choose the best dishes.

The food was more than excellent, fresh, tasty, and full of flavor. The portion sizes were just right and generous. Every dish was prepared with care and beautifully presented.

The atmosphere of the restaurant was cozy and friendly, perfect for enjoying a nice meal. I will definitely come back again and recommend this place to anyone who loves real Italian food.

Another amazing big mama restaurant! Honestly the best one out of them all in London! Great service by the Dr. , who gave phenomenal and attentive service! Food hit the Italian craving and the ambience is perfect. Went for lunch but will definitely come back for dinner.

I had an exceptional evening here! The food and drinks were spot on, and the service was simply outstanding—our server greeted us warmly and knew the menu inside out, which made choosing our meals a breeze. The vibes in the place were perfect, and everything was spotless. I really appreciated how the team checked in on us and even recommended dessert—it was such a nice touch. I can’t wait to come back!

I usually challenge such expensive restaurants as I believe it is difficult to justify such amount of money for one meal... yet Gaucho deserves a 5 star.

They have it all. The location at Canary Wharf might not be ideal, yet it is right in front of the river with amazing view over centtal London skyline, so a plus already for terrace sitting if weathwr allows.
Next is service. Perfect. Polite, attentive, not intrusive yet always there whenever you need something.
Finally the food. We went for Gaucho's classic: Argentinian meet. We took different cuts and ALL of the were cooked according to each one request, from filete to ribeye steaks, different sizes and some marinated. All amazing.

We went for Argentinian malvec... quite overpriced yet very good.

All together in a cosy place.

Just excellent experience end-to-end.

Illustration: 400 ribeye steak for 52£

Labels: 2eat, $$$$, #Argentinian, #romantic, #privees, #terrace, #views, #must Go

I visited recently and had an exceptional experience, thanks to the team's top-notch service and their excellent menu knowledge. The food and drinks were absolutely delightful, and the atmosphere made it even better. While I felt the prices were a bit on the high side, the quality of what I had definitely justified it. Overall, I walked away with a full stomach and a big smile, thanks to the warm greetings and thoughtful recommendations throughout my visit. I'll definitely be returning!

We went here for my birthday lunch.  The greeting was lovely & friendly.
The restaurant wasn’t very busy, which was good. Gauchos is a restaurant that I had been to before, many years ago & the presentation of the restaurant is still very good.
We ordered cocktails which were ok. I don’t usually drink but as I was celebrating I had a pornstar martini which was nice but I usually feel a little tipsy after one of these but with this one I didn’t. The others like their cocktails but they also said they lacked any taste with regard to alcohol content.
We all ordered from the set lunch menu. It was 3 courses for £19.95
We had the Prawn Chicharron for starters. It was lovely! I would definitely order this from the main menu, if it guaranteed that I got a bigger portion😊10/10
Mains, we had Rump & chips. I also ordered a side of tenderstem broccoli. The steaks were nice, not amazing, but nice. I was hoping for home made chips, even if I was only given a few chips presented nicely. Sadly, it looked like we were given McCain chips 6.5/10
They tasted ok though.
The broccoli was weird. It had peanuts crumbed on it & some sort of drizzled sauce. We didn’t like it 2/10
For dessert we all had Chocolate Brownie with  white chocolate ice cream. I love desserts. It was adequate. We were all unsure on the taste of the ice cream 7/10.
Ooh..! They did write happy birthday on my plate with my dessert & put a candle in it, which was really nice. Thank you ❤️

Only gripe is, when we were eating dessert not all of us had finished & the plates were collected. He then made one of our party feel rushed & uneasy.

I will say that the aesthetics of the restaurant are lovely. The staff were pleasant. The food, for the price, was really good.

P.s your bathrooms could do with a little bit more light.

I would definitely return to this restaurant

A hidden gem and the best Gaucho of the franchise. Excellent value, sharp service and a divine setting for any occasion. For a mid-week treat, try the three course set menu. For dinner, our favourite steak is the ribeye, every time.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (4/5)
Dinner at Blacklock Canary Wharf – Tuesday Evening

I went for dinner at Blacklock Canary Wharf with a friend on Tuesday evening, and we had a lovely time. I ordered a well-done steak (that’s how we eat it where I come from), with gravy, sweet potatoes, kale with parmesan, and ice cream for dessert, along with a glass of red wine.

The food was excellent. The steak was a bit chewy, as you’d expect from well-done, but still full of flavour. Everything else, especially the sides and dessert, was absolutely delicious. The staff were amazing throughout; very friendly and attentive, though I didn’t catch the name of the person who served us.

The only slightly disappointing moment was when we were asked to give up our table after two hours, not rudely, but simply because of their policy. To be honest, it’s a sign of how much we were enjoying ourselves that we didn’t want to leave! We would have happily stayed for another round of drinks.

Overall, a great evening with excellent food, warm service, and a vibrant atmosphere. I’d definitely go back — maybe I’ll just book a longer slot next time!

Absolutely delicious Sunday roast—the meats were full of flavor, and the gravy was simply outstanding. The only reason it’s not five stars is the portion size: despite looking large, about 80% of the plate was vegetables, leaving the actual amount of meat underwhelming. For two people, the portion for three is ideal.

For dessert, we had the white chocolate cheesecake, and it was pure heaven. Unlike the roast, a single portion of dessert was more than enough for two people.

12 out of 10.
10 for the food — from starters and steaks to desserts, they consistently surprised us. Highly recommend the pork’s head on toast, triple-cooked chips, broccoli and walnut salad, prime rib, white chocolate cheesecake, and mango sorbet (alright — that’s nearly everything we ordered!).

An extra 2 points for the friendly and attentive service. Thank you to the lovely Jess and Ryan — their recommendations were spot on.

We really enjoyed it! Definitely recommend!

One of the best Sunday Roasts I’ve ever had in London! The gravy was amazing totally impressed🤩🤩 The dessert is a must-try!! I can’t remember the name, but it was some kind of white chocolate treat and it was so good!! If you’re planning to come, I’d definitely recommend booking ahead

Went here with a work group and had a fantastic feast. The steak was excellent — not the oversized kind, which made it perfect for sharing and trying different cuts across the table. Appetisers were solid too, well-prepared and a great way to kick things off.

We had a round of drinks at the bar while waiting for our table, which set a nice tone before dinner. Service during the meal was friendly and efficient, but once the dinner rush picked up we did feel a bit hurried to vacate the table — understandable for such a busy spot, but worth knowing if you’re looking for a more leisurely evening.

Overall, Blacklock Canary Wharf delivers on quality food, lively atmosphere, and good group dining — just be prepared for a bustling pace.

places.name: Kricket Canary Wharf Restaurant
places.formatted_address: Unit 6 Frobisher Psge, London E14 5HA, UK
places.vicinity: Cabot Square, Unit 6 Frobisher Psge, London

reviews.text:
Outstanding service with awesome food. Don't tell mum but I can't taste the difference!!
Highlights include the perfectly cooked prawns, Bhapa Doi (sweetened yoghurt) with mango Mille-Feuille and the legendary Claypot Baked Cod (large dreamy flaky chunks of moist cod with a crispy skin in a rich cocunut sauce - how does chef get it flaky and crispy?). Thank you chef for customising my wife's Bhapa Doi with extra mango and cream. It really looked and tasted sensational. It was the best food experience this year! Don't forget to round off with the beautifully balanced masala chai in a glass... authentic and very very good. We look forward to trying the new Autumn/Winter menu.

We had a wonderful Sunday lunch experience here - Holly has great service and introduced the menu very well. The food is really nice and in great portions, delicious, hot - the prawns, the lamb & fried chicken, and everything is just so tasty. The desserts are fresh and delicious. Moreover, the cocktails are very refreshing. Definitely recommend!

I’ve never understood when I’ve been told that the UK has great Indian restaurants until I decided to try one in London! We were not let down at all by every meal. The location is very unassuming with its minimal exterior but simple and functional on the inside with vibrant colours to match. Going out with kids also makes it a challenge to find a decent restaurant that caters as such, and Kricket were amazing due to their Kids Thali options.
We had the 3 small plates with the Cod as a main and every dish was fantastic. Uniquely tasting Curry Leaf Mayo paired nicely with chicken while the banana leaf wrapped Cod brought on nostalgia from cooking back home in Durban, South Africa. Will be trying out other locations soon!

Visited Kricket Canary Wharf and had a great experience overall. The restaurant is spacious with a relaxed atmosphere, and staff were friendly and helpful, especially for first-time diners.

Tried the Mangalorean Chicken Gassi and the Karnatakan Pork Neck — both were rich, flavourful, and went perfectly with rice. Also had the masala naan, which was tasty, though the topping slightly overpowered the curries when dipping. Finished the meal with a warm and fragrant masala chai, which was a highlight.

The baby changing facilities were spacious and very comfortable — a thoughtful detail that doesn’t go unnoticed.

Would definitely return for a curry fix.

We came for an early dinner and the food was mostly good! I had the tomato rasam pani puri (nice bite) then between the two of us, we shared the Keralan fried chicken (great texture and flavour), Recheado butter prawns (the flavour was on point and it was my favourite), grilled squash makhani (felt the squash wasn't seasoned even when in the rich sauce) and the cod (perfectly cooked) with sides of paratha, rice and the green mango kachumber salad (cut through some of the richness of the mains). The staff were helpful and polite.

I loved this place. Best vegan Sunday roast I’ve ever had. The mushroom was to die for. The veg and gravy were so tasty. The portion side perfect. Yes it’s pretty expensive I guess £30 a head for main meal but actually I’d go again. The cocktail were generous and strong which I liked. As an older person ( I’m 67 )  I often feel a bit invisible in modern restaurants-slightly ignored. Not here, staff seemed keen to engage and not in a patronising way at all. We felt welcomed , well served and left with a warm feeling of being cared about. Thank you all x

I recently had the pleasure of dining at one of my favorite restaurants in Canary Wharf.

The staff was attentive without being intrusive, ensuring that all our needs were met with promptness and a smile! Every dish we tried was beautifully presented and bursting with flavor. The ingredients tasted fresh and high-quality.

Overall, it's a perfect combination of fantastic service and delicious food.
I highly recommend this restaurant.

To begin with i am a big fan of Fallow the youtube channel and ive also dined with my girlfriend at Fallow in December last year. I feel I may have ate here on a day where only the Junior staff were working or i just was not that important cause it all felt very basic. I have been looking forward to this meal for months. The first dish I ordered was the blooming onion and it looked stunning and tasted really yummy but towards the bottom end I felt like there was a lot of oil which did not seem like it was drained out well. The next dish I ordered was the grilled octopus and it was really salty and I hoped for less salt as I ate all of it but it left a bad taste it my mouth. I also conveyed this message to the staff when he asked for feedback. The last savoury dish I ordered was the mortadella flatbread and it lacked a bit of a punchy flavour from the parmesan cheese or may be it was the octopus that changed the taste in my mouth. The banana parfait and the ice tea were the best dishes I ate. I felt the service team needed to be more friendly as i did not feel that. I feel the next time I visit such establishments I need to have a guest with me and only then I will get the respect i need cause it all fell flat. The Ambience of the restaurant is great but will only return to Fallow and definitely not here.

Have visited a couple times and this time was ever better than the last.

You cannot go wrong with the mushroom parfait, which tastes the same as the one from the parent restaurant, Fallow.

If the chicken wings are on the menu, get them! They are so delicious!

We came on a weekend where there was brunch, so we finally tried the Royale with cheese and can confirm it’s worth the try. The banana bread with bacon was also very good. Also can’t go wrong with hash browns.

The atmosphere and service here is always top notch.

They are dog friendly and even have a little dog menu, how cute! They’ve got outdoor seating but we were happy to be seated inside as it’s quite hot. They reserved a very spacious area for us since we’ve got a dog. There was so much we wanted to try on the menu but we went for a couple of small plates to share. We were surprised the mushroom parfait would be our favourite dish! It’s got so much flavour and has a silky smooth texture. We liked all the other dishes too apart from the cuttlefish toast which we found a bit greasy and heavy. Our dog enjoyed his steak and ate it very fast. The cocktails were really nice too. We ended our meal with some delicious desserts. Definitely want to come back again!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ – Elegant Atmosphere & Great Vibes
Brera Lounge is the perfect spot for a night out in London. The vibe is classy yet welcoming, with stylish interiors with luxurious feels. The music is great- DJ was lit. Food great- pizza- mouth watering and the drinks were crafted beautifully. I had such a great time. Will be back!

The music and vibe made it a perfect place to have fun with friends over drinks and good pizza. Great service and lovely atmosphere. Highly recommend if you're looking for great time out with great food! ✨🥳

Brera Lounge in Canary Wharf absolutely nails it. The pepperoni pizza was spot-on—crispy crust, rich sauce, and perfectly cooked pepperoni with just the right kick.

The cherry on top? The vibe. They had 90s classics playing for tonight—TLC, Biggie, Aaliyah—which made the whole experience feel fun and laid-back. Great food, great music, great spot.

Amazing Drinks & Service
I had such a great time at Brera Lounge. The cocktails are some of the best I’ve tried in the city, and the staff really go out of their way to make sure you’re having a good time. It’s the ideal mix of sophistication and fun. Highly recommend if you want a memorable night.

Ordered 3 Gelato Mantecato... One of these was almost pure fluid, not even frozen.  Mixed nuts on all three turned out to be just salted peanuts.    The food was drop and run.  Will not be coming back their again!

places.name: ROKA Canary Wharf
places.formatted_address: 4, Park Pavillion, 40 Canada Square, London E14 5FW, UK
places.vicinity: 4, Park Pavillion, Cabot Square, 40 Canada Square, London
places.editorial_summary: Premium sushi & grilled Japanese offerings in a refined, warmly furnished dining destination.

reviews.text:
I really enjoyed my first time coming to this restaurant with friends. Lovely food, lovely staff. Price is totally worth it. Super recommend it (:

The only minor here is the atmosphere can get really noisy, people don’t do normal talk, the shouting to each other. But completely understandable this is something staff cannot control.

Apart from that fabulous experience

ROKA!
I must admit I was most impressed with
1) the attentiveness of the staff
2) the food spread and its frequency of replenishment
3) the guy who made sure my glass wasn’t dry for a second.

Came here for my cousins birthday. 4 guests in total.
We all went for the free flowing; most went sparking wine, I opted for red wine.
The starters came rumbling in and we dug in, to my surprise they were pretty good. It just kept on coming and coming. Lol. At some point we had to stop the starters as we suddenly remembered that the main meal was still on the way.
In the spirit of going all out, I had ordered the Tomahawk 1KG as well.

The steak was really good, cooked just right. At this point the red wine had started its number on me but the steak came and doused it down a bit lol.

I have had a few “brunches” around town, but ROKA actually is easily a top 3 experience. The service just made the time there much much better.

I’d definitely go back again.

Absolutely fabulous experience at this trendy Japanese restaurant ! Being a novice , my friend guided me to the menu and the waiter was fab ! Marius is the best manager ever ! I dropped my bus pass and he realized it was mine and came over straight away to hand it over…. Superb food , the weekend brunch is excellent value and the Bellini to start with is awesome ! The starters are so filling ! The main is so good - I had baby pork ribs , hubby had yakitori salmon and a lot of my friends had the black cod ! The service was impeccable and the drinks were free flowing ! Staff attitude is exceptional ! Everything about the place is fab ! 11/10 ! Will be returning soon !

Favourable & Delightful Experience – But Not Perfect 4/5

Two of us came here for lunch with high expectations after reading glowing reviews and dining at many top establishments. We were very hungry and ready to be impressed.

Upon arrival, we were warmly greeted and taken to our seats. Our waiter was friendly, attentive, and took the time to explain his recommendations. We opted for the seasonal tasting menu at £88 per person, having been assured there would be plenty of food.

The Meal:

The dishes started to arrive, one by one:
•	Sake to Avokado Maki (raw salmon, avocado, and asparagus, with wasabi tobiko and tenkasu): Fresh, clean flavours, complemented nicely by the wasabi and ginger. Much better than any supermarket sushi.
•	Goma Fuumi no Horenso Salada (spinach leaves with sesame dressing – GF, VG): Light, tasty, and refreshing. A great addition to any meal – highly recommend.
•	Sashimi Moriawase (tuna, seabass, and salmon sashimi): Two small pieces of each fish. Very fresh, but a bit bland on their own. The soy sauce helped bring some life to them.
•	Hamachi no Taru Taru (yellowtail tartare, lemon, chilli, and ginger pearls – GF): Fresh and mildly flavoured, but didn’t stand out. Served with two thin edible crackers that reminded me of light Quavers – not very impactful in flavour.
•	Gyuniku to Goma no Gyoza (beef, ginger, and sesame dumplings): The highlight of the meal! Crispy outside, juicy and flavourful inside, paired with a delicious sauce, chillies, and cucumber. We only wished there were more – two each wasn’t enough!
•	Kuruma-Ebi (tiger prawn tempura with tentsuyu and spicy yuzu sauce): Another standout. Served hot and fresh, with a satisfying crunch. Left a warm, hearty feeling.
•	Kobuta no Ribs Yawaraka Nikomiyaki (baby back pork ribs with sansho and cashew nuts): Great flavour and texture, though the ribs were small with little meat.

Main Dishes:
1.	Hinadori no Lemon Miso Yaki (cedar roast baby chicken with chilli and lemon – GF): My favourite main dish. Bold, mouthwatering flavours. Served hot and packed a punch.
2.	Konasu (eggplant in mirin, ginger, and soy – GF, VG): Moist and sweet with a distinct flavour. If you’re a fan of eggplant, you’ll enjoy it – though it wasn’t quite to my taste.
3.	Tai no Miso-Yaki (seabream fillet, ryotei miso, and red onion – GF): Very soft and fresh, with delicate flavours. A nice contrast to the other dishes, though it didn’t stand out in terms of taste.

Dessert:

We ended with the Roka Dessert Platter. Everything was enjoyable except the sticky toffee pudding, which was overcooked, dry, and tough – a real letdown.

Extras:

We had four Diet Cokes between us and a bottle of water, priced at £5.95. There’s also a £1 charity donation added to the bill and a 14.5% service charge (optional, but included automatically).

Final Thoughts:

Our total came to £226.51 for two. It’s definitely on the expensive side, and while the service was excellent and many dishes impressed, not everything lived up to the hype. Some items lacked depth or portion size for the price.

That said, we still had a great experience. I’d highly recommend select dishes (like the gyoza, prawn tempura, and baby chicken), but others I’d probably skip next time.

Roka was a real delight with a stunning array of food options. We were part of a large group, dining on the 2nd floor terrace and had a set menu, which meant we got to try many of the delicious dishes that Roka has to offer from the Tasting Menu.

Absolute stand outs included; Yellowtail Sashimi, Rock Shrimp Tempura, Lamb Cutlets with Korean Spices, Angus Beef fillet and the Black Cod marinated in yuzu miso. The assorted Roka dessert was also amazing, so much variety to enjoy.

A broad range of drinks options to suit most preferences is also available. And the service was polite, but a little slow.

We were looking forward to this place for a while and heard/read all the reviews about this restaurant. It did not disappoint. The moment we walked through the doors, we knew this would be an authentic Indian experience. Hussain (manager) and Monica (waitress) went above and beyond to deliver an exceptional service. They were attentive, very knowledgeable about the food and helpful. The dishes served were 10/10 and the portion sizes were perfect. I would highly x 2 recommend this restaurant for a date night, meet-up,  a group gathering or any occasion. This place delivered and the chefs done good!

Overall amazing! Truly cannot fault a single thing we were served. The service was just so lovely and inviting, the food was some of the best south Asian I’ve had that Is not authentically home made!
I’m so gutted I didn’t take pictures of the ruby biryani and the mutton curry, because they were faultless We just couldn’t wait to dig in!
Those prawns were honestly spectacular! Spicy and just the perfect grill. Think it was by far the best on the menu.

There’s nothing that I didn’t like about this place. The food was amazing. The lamb chops were out of the world. Okra fries (5)are a must. Chicken ruby(5) was amazing. Daal (4.5)was great too. Naans were thin and yum. The paneer roomali roll was great roo (4.5/5)
Our server Massimo was amazing too

Best restaurant for modernized Indian food. Service is amazing, staff is very friendly and helpful. The food also is very good, and not your standard Indian food, but thoughtfully put together modernized versions of it. They have a separate vegan menu for breakfast, lunch and dinner. It's well worth a visit.

We wanted to visit the Canary Wharf
Branch as we have enjoyed other branches
Especially Shoreditch.

We got lost on our way to the area
But once we got to Canary Wharf Station
It was fairly easy to find.

We liked the ambiance & Decor
Everyone we met was very welcoming
Even though it was near to closing time

We were offered water to drink
& Were served very quickly

The Up-To-Date Pau Bhaji was delicious
But we struggled to finish the portion
So requested to box the leftovers

The server was polite & Said
That He will have to check with
The manager

Then He gave us the packaging
To fill up the containers ourselves.

We were happy not to waste
Such delicious food.

We definitely enjoyed ourselves
& Will try to come visit soon

Although we liked where we sat
We would prefer to sit maybe
Outside next time, As it was very dark.

Happy 15th to the Dishoom family
Compliments to the Manager

Thank you to Alex for serving us
& The delightful lady for giving us
Water to drink.

Best wishes to everyone
At Dishoom Canary Wharf.

places.name: Hawksmoor Wood Wharf
places.editorial_summary: Prime cuts of matured beef, seafood & other British classics served in striking environs.

reviews.text: I’ve been to Hawksmoor in Dublin and London a couple of times and always love the food and customer service. Our visit to Hawksmoor Wood Wharf yesterday was no different. The bone marrow with onion was a fantastic starter, and the steaks were good even without the sauces. The creamed spinach and garlic mushrooms were great sides. We enjoyed the meal with red wine and finished it with ice cream and sorbet. Good food, great customer service, and reasonable prices.

Came here for my birthday with my husband. We tried Sunday roast and it did not disappoint. For starters, we had the bone marrow and it was good especially with cracked salt on sourdough bread. We had the rump roast beef (Sunday roast), I ordered mine pink and my husband well done. Mine was so tender, melts in your mouth experience. It had a nice portion of fat which I really liked. They also granted our request for extra gravy. Delicious food.

The staff are all very friendly and accommodating.  The atmosphere great. Location impeccable. Their toilet facilities well maintained, clean which is really important.

They gave me a complimentary sorbet with candle as it was my birthday, really thoughtful touch. Thank you Hawksmoor for the amazing experience.

Rib eye cooked to perfection - medium rare spot on. Sirloin was also delicious.
Starters were great too: Bone Marrow & Caesar salad.
Peanut butter shortbread dessert was the icing on the cake. Yummy!

Although it’s a steakhouse, I ordered fish and it was cooked to perfection, also don’t miss the oysters, they’re packed with flavor and wonderfully tender.

Lovely staff 🤗
I’d recommend this spot for a besties night out, a romantic date, or even a relaxed family outing.

The outdoor seating has a beautiful view and ambiance.

We ordered the Sunday roast and bone marrow oysters as starters. Loved the oysters, really fresh and had good flavours. Sunday roast was served on a hot plate which was greatly appreciated, everything on the plate was fantastic other than the potatoes which were slightly hard on the outside. However, when we brought it up to the staff, they promptly gave a feedback to the kitchen and even offered us a sticky toffee pudding on the house as a compensation. Really appreciated the good service and would highly recommend the Sunday roast to anyone coming here!

We had the absolute best time enjoying the Space menu at Six for my birthday celebrations. Staff were fantastic throughout and all of the food and drink was delicious. The cocktail pairing menu was tasty and great value! All of the food was well-considered and beautifully presented. I couldn’t recommend it enough, we had a fantastic time. Thank you!

Really enjoyed our experience today for their space themed menu.

I think from reading reviews and hearing other experiences. I think people are expecting what they’d get from a Michelin star restaurant.

I’ve eaten from Michelin star restaurants before and doesn’t compare? No,. But it’s close. I think this is more budget friendly for people who want to enjoy a similar experience but not pay the cost that comes with it.

Was it cheap?  No but you can opt out of extras and would maybe £60pp. We got staters and the wine pairing for each course (they are pretty generous with wine portions)

But it was busy. It was a tad noisy but the staff were amazing and friendly. Very knowledgeable on the menu and wine pairings for each course And I would 100% go back.

The food portions look small, but we had six courses and was full by the end and I have a pretty big appetite.

I think it’s definitely worth a visit And I will be going back for their Christmas menu.

Had such a great evening at Six by Nico Canary Wharf trying their Space themed 6-course tasting menu with wine pairing. Every dish was creative, beautifully presented, and full of flavour; the wine pairings really lifted the experience. The service was warm, attentive, and made the whole night feel easy and enjoyable. Standouts for me were the Zero Gravity Oyster and the Solar Flare and the pairing that went with it. The pacing between courses gave us time to enjoy without ever feeling rushed. Big thanks to the team, we’ll definitely be back again for the next menu!

This was my partners and I second time here at Six by Nico. We had the APOLLO 11 course meal and the experience was absolutely fantastic! To the detail of flavours and presentation it was an experience to say the least. I would definitely recommend to anyone who is looking for a dinner with a fantastic experience!
Had the San Sebastián tasting menu - what a real treat. Food was beautifully presented and tasted amazing, service was great and the price was good value. Definitely plan to go back.

places.name: Amerigo Vespucci
places.editorial_summary: Italian restaurant with a classic menu and an outdoor terrace, set among the towers of Canary Wharf.

reviews.text:
Chill vibes, and a small, quaint atmosphere, makes this place a romantic-like dining spot.
Great service, great food.
We enjoyed the 24hr skimmed ragu spaghetti.  Super yummy.
Brownie and pear desert were a nice finishing touch.

One of the best Italian restaurants, period. My half Italian side was very happy.

It's not that the food was absolutely delicious and outstanding, no, it's not supposed to be! The food was put simply, perfect! Wine selection is ok too.

5 stars for food and service. It shows their strong tradition.
Would give 5 stars to atmosphere as well, it it wasn't for the cigarette smoke coming from people sitting outside, it kinda of ruined the amazing taste of a well made Italian pasta...

Perhaps they should invest on a HVAC or tweak the sitting for the smokers outside, because eating an ash tray is not cool.

We really enjoyed going to this restaurant.  Location is great with views of the wharf. Food was delicious.  Well presented and tasty. Wine list and cocktails is great as well.
And the service, especially for us a party of over 20, was superb.
Highly recommended for big or small parties.

"This fabulous London Italian spot is a must-visit whenever we're in town!
Incredible food, impeccable service (special thanks to Oskar for his warmth and help). We devoured the starter and main too quickly for photos, but the stunning, delicious dessert made the shot.
Pro tip: always reserve in advance!"

Very good food. Enjoyed the pasta very much (and that’s said by an italian). Decent portions and very very tasty. I also probably had the best rum baba I’ve ever had in London. The service very nice. Was much better than was expecting.
